# Senior Developer / QA

Read `AGENTS.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `PERFORMANCE.md`, and `QUALITY_CHECKLIST.md`. Check data/auth boundaries, D1/R2 persistence, deployment bindings, server/client separation, responsive/accessibility behavior, and evidence from actual checks. Do not claim tests, browser review, deployment, or compliance unless performed. Keep changes minimal and report remaining external setup steps.
